About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Over ons

A. Algemene vragen

1. Is deze site veilig in gebruik?

Ja. De betaalomgeving wordt veilig gehost door Shopify en ondersteunt de betaalmethoden die bij het afrekenen worden getoond. We bewaren je volledige kaartgegevens niet op onze website.

 

2. Hoe snel reageren jullie op e-mailvragen?

We beantwoorden alle e-mails binnen één werkdag.

 

3. Waar zijn jullie gevestigd?

Dress Like Mommy is een webwinkel die wordt beheerd door FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, VS. We werken samen met productiepartners en partners voor de afhandeling van bestellingen.

 

4. Waarom zijn jullie zo goedkoop?

We selecteren bijpassende gezinsoutfits met betaalbaarheid in gedachten. Prijzen en beschikbare kortingen worden op de productpagina en bij het afrekenen getoond.

Voordat je een bestelling plaatst

A. Maten

1. Waar kan ik de maattabel in centimeters vinden?

Gebruik de maattabel voor het specifieke product en de maat die je overweegt. Controleer de eenheden en of de tabel lichaamsmaten of kledingmaten vermeldt. Onze maatgids legt uit hoe je meet en maten vergelijkt. Neem vóór het bestellen contact met ons op als een tabel of maat onduidelijk is.

 

2. Krijg ik een artikel dat twee maten groter is?

Maatlabels en afmetingen verschillen per product en fabrikant. Kies elk kledingstuk aan de hand van de eigen maattabel en de beschikbare opties, in plaats van uit te gaan van je gebruikelijke lettermaat of een vaste maatomrekening toe te passen. Neem bij twijfel vóór het bestellen contact met ons op.

B. Betalingen

1. Welke betaalmethoden accepteren jullie?

We accepteren de betaalmethoden die bij het afrekenen worden weergegeven, waaronder de beschikbare opties voor kaartbetalingen.

 

2. Ik wil met mijn creditcard betalen, maar ik word doorgestuurd naar de PayPal-pagina?

Kies bij het afrekenen een beschikbare betaalmethode. Als je een externe betaaldienst kiest, volg dan de instructies van die aanbieder of kies vóór de betaling een andere beschikbare optie.

C. Verzending

1. Wat is de verzendprijs?

Standaardverzending is inbegrepen in de productprijzen voor landen en regio’s waar een standaardmethode beschikbaar is. Vóór de betaling zie je de exacte verzendmethode, de verwachte levertijd en een eventuele optie voor expresverzending.

 

2. Levert u in mijn land?

We verzenden naar de landen en regio’s die bij het afrekenen worden weergegeven. Staat je land daar niet bij, neem dan contact met ons op voordat je een bestelling plaatst.

 

3. Hoe lang duurt het voordat ik mijn bestelling ontvang?

De verwerkings- en vervoerstijden verschillen per bestemming en vervoerder. Lees vóór het afrekenen het verzendbeleid voor de actuele verzendinformatie.

 

4. Moet ik douanekosten betalen?

Het land van bestemming kan douanerechten, invoerbelastingen of lokale kosten in rekening brengen. Deze zijn voor rekening van de klant, tenzij bij het afrekenen uitdrukkelijk wordt vermeld dat ze inbegrepen zijn. We kunnen bestellingen niet als cadeau of als zending met een lagere waarde aangeven.

Nadat je een bestelling hebt geplaatst

A. Orderstatus

1. Wat betekent de orderstatus "Onvervuld"?

Je bestelling is nog niet als afgehandeld gemarkeerd. Bestellingen worden doorgaans binnen 1-3 werkdagen na de betalingsbevestiging verwerkt. Beschikbare trackinginformatie wordt na verzending per e-mail toegestuurd.

 

2. Wat betekent de orderstatus "Voltooid"?

Dat betekent dat uw bestelling wordt verzonden.

 

3. Het duurt te lang, waar is mijn bestelling?

Controleer alstublieft de tracking van uw bestelling voor meer informatie. Als het probleem blijft bestaan, stuur dan een e-mail naar: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Ordertracking

1. Hoe kan ik mijn bestelling volgen?

Trackinginformatie wordt per e-mail toegestuurd zodra deze na verzending van je bestelling beschikbaar is. Je kunt de informatie ook hier bekijken: Je bestelling volgen

 

2. Mijn trackingcode zegt “in afwachting” of “momenteel geen informatie beschikbaar”.

Het kan 24-48 uur duren voordat de trackinginformatie wordt bijgewerkt nadat het trackingnummer is verstrekt. Als er nog steeds geen informatie beschikbaar is of je pakket vertraging heeft, neem dan contact met ons op: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Mijn trackingcode zegt “verlopen”

Neem alstublieft contact met ons op: info@dresslikemommy.com en wij lossen dit probleem snel voor u op.

 

4. Hoe blijf ik op de hoogte van mijn ordertracking?

Gebruik de trackinglink voor de laatste updates van de vervoerder. Als je pakket vertraagd of zoek is, of als bezorgd wordt vermeld terwijl je het niet hebt ontvangen, neem dan contact met ons op met je bestelnummer en trackinginformatie.

B. Ik wil mijn bestelling wijzigen of annuleren

1. Ik heb iets besteld, maar ik wil annuleren

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar info@dresslikemommy.com met uw bestelnummer als onderwerp.

 

2. Ik heb iets besteld, maar wil de kleur of maat van het artikel wijzigen.

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar info@dresslikemommy.com met uw nieuwe kleur- of maatoptie.

 

3. Ik heb iets besteld, maar wil het afleveradres wijzigen

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar info@dresslikemommy.com met uw nieuwe afleveradres.

Nadat u een bestelling heeft ontvangen

A. Ik wil mijn bestelling wijzigen of retourneren

1. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen, maar de artikelen waren twee maten te groot

Maatlabels kunnen verschillen. Als de maat of afmetingen niet lijken overeen te komen met je bestelling, neem dan contact op via info@dresslikemommy.com en vermeld je bestelnummer en de details. Lees ons huidige terugbetalingsbeleid voordat je een artikel terugstuurt.

 

2. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen, maar ik heb de verkeerde artikelen ontvangen

Neem alstublieft contact met ons op via info@dresslikemommy.com en geef ons uw bestelnummer door. Als wij in fout zijn, kunt u de artikelen naar ons terugsturen en sturen wij u de juiste artikelen op onze kosten (of betalen wij het bedrag terug).

Shipping Information

At Dress Like Mommy, we are an online store that ships matching family outfits to destinations available at checkout through our shipping and fulfillment partners. Here is how to confirm shipping, delivery timing, and tracking before you place an order.

Standard And Express Shipping Options

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Where We Ship

Shipping availability is based on the country/region and address entered at checkout. If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, we can ship there under the displayed method and rate.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown, email us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Processing And Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout. Review the shipping method and estimate shown during checkout before placing your order.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued.

Order Tracking

Once your order ships, check your email for tracking information. You can also visit your account or use the tracking link in the shipping confirmation email when available.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping FAQ

Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
Contact us as soon as possible at info@dresslikemommy.com. If your order has not moved into fulfillment yet, we can review whether an address change is still possible.

Do you ship to P.O. Boxes?
Shipping availability for P.O. Boxes depends on the destination and carrier options shown at checkout.

My package has not arrived yet.
Check your tracking link first. If the tracking has not updated for several business days or the delivery estimate has passed, email us with your order number.

Verzendinformatie

Dress Like Mommy is een webwinkel die via onze verzend- en afhandelingspartners bijpassende gezinsoutfits verstuurt naar bestemmingen die bij het afrekenen beschikbaar zijn. Hier lees je hoe je de verzending, levertijd en tracking controleert voordat je bestelt.

Standaard- en expresverzending

Standaardverzending is inbegrepen in de productprijzen voor landen en regio’s waar een standaardverzendmethode beschikbaar is. Bij het afrekenen zie je vóór de betaling de exacte verzendmethode, de verwachte levertijd en een eventuele optie voor expresverzending.

Waarheen we verzenden

De beschikbaarheid van verzending hangt af van het land/de regio en het adres die bij het afrekenen zijn ingevoerd. Als er voor je adres een verzendmethode wordt getoond, kunnen we daarheen verzenden met de weergegeven methode en tegen het weergegeven tarief.

Als je bestemming niet verschijnt bij het afrekenen of er geen verzendmethode wordt getoond, mail ons dan vóór het bestellen op info@dresslikemommy.com.

Verwerkings- en levertijden

Bestellingen worden binnen 1-3 werkdagen na bevestiging van de betaling verwerkt. Tijdens feestdagen, promoties of periodes met grote volumes kan de verwerking extra 1-2 werkdagen in beslag nemen.

De geschatte levertijden verschillen per bestemming, vervoerder, douaneafhandeling en verzendmethode die bij het afrekenen wordt getoond. Controleer de weergegeven verzendmethode en geschatte levertijd voordat je bestelt.

Het kan 24-48 uur na de afgifte van het trackingnummer duren voordat de tracking wordt bijgewerkt.

Je bestelling volgen

Controleer je e-mail op trackinginformatie zodra je bestelling is verzonden. Je kunt ook je account bezoeken of de trackinglink in de verzendbevestiging gebruiken wanneer die beschikbaar is.

Douane, invoerrechten en invoerbelastingen

Voor bestellingen die buiten de Verenigde Staten worden verzonden, kan het land van bestemming of de vervoerder invoerrechten, belastingen, makelaarskosten of douanekosten in rekening brengen. Deze kosten zijn de verantwoordelijkheid van de klant, tenzij bij het afrekenen expliciet staat dat ze inbegrepen zijn.

We kunnen deze kosten niet voorspellen, bestellingen als geschenken markeren of de aangegeven waarde van een bestelling verlagen. Neem contact op met uw plaatselijke douanekantoor voor bestemmingsspecifieke richtlijnen voordat u bestelt.

Veelgestelde vragen over verzending

Kan ik mijn verzendadres na het bestellen wijzigen?
Neem zo snel mogelijk contact op via info@dresslikemommy.com. Als je bestelling nog niet in de afhandelingsfase zit, kunnen we nagaan of een adreswijziging nog mogelijk is.

Verzenden jullie naar postbussen?
Verzending naar postbussen hangt af van de bestemming en de vervoerdersopties die bij het afrekenen worden getoond.

Mijn pakket is nog niet aangekomen.
Controleer eerst je trackinglink. Als de tracking al enkele werkdagen niet is bijgewerkt of de geschatte leverdatum voorbij is, mail ons dan met je bestelnummer.

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Shipping Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

At Dress Like Mommy, we want your matching outfits to arrive as clearly and reliably as possible. Review the shipping method, rate, and delivery estimate shown at checkout before placing an order.

Where We Ship

Shipping is available to the countries and regions shown at checkout. Availability depends on the destination, product, and shipping methods shown during checkout. Use the country/region selector or the checkout shipping step to confirm whether we can ship to your address before placing an order.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown for your address, contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Shipping Rates

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

You will receive an email with tracking information once your order ships.

Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout.

  • Standard Delivery: the current checkout estimate displays before payment.
  • Express Delivery: available for some destinations where shown at checkout.

These are estimates. Actual delivery times may vary because of customs processing, carrier delays, weather, holidays, or local conditions.

How Our Shipping Works

  1. Order Placed: you receive an order confirmation email.
  2. Order Processing: your order is prepared after payment confirmation.
  3. Shipped: tracking information is emailed when available.
  4. In Transit: use the tracking link for carrier updates.
  5. Delivered: your package is delivered to the address provided at checkout.

Order Tracking

Every order includes a tracking number when the carrier provides one. Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the number is issued.

You can also check your order status anytime by visiting our Order Status page.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders shipped outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These charges are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping Problems

If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and tracking information. We will help review the carrier information and next available steps.

Contact Us

For shipping questions, email info@dresslikemommy.com.

Forsendelsespolicy

Sist oppdatert: januar 28, 2026

A På Dress Like Mommy ønsker vi at matchende antrekk skal komme frem så tydelig og pålitelig som mulig. Gå gjennom fraktmetoden, prisen og leveringsestimatet som vises i kassen før du legger inn en bestilling.

Hvor vi sender

Frakt er tilgjengelig for landene og regionene som vises i kassen. Tilgjengelighet avhenger av destinasjonen, produktet og fraktmetodene som vises under kassen. Bruk land-/regionvelgeren eller betalingstrinnet for å bekrefte om vi kan sende til adressen din før du legger inn en bestilling.

Hvis destinasjonen din ikke vises i kassen, eller hvis ingen fraktmetode vises for adressen din, kontakt oss på info@dresslikemommy.com før du bestiller.

Fraktpriser

Standardfrakt er inkludert i produktprisene for land og regioner der en standardmetode er tilgjengelig. Checkout viser nøyaktig metode, leveringsestimat og eventuell ekspressoppgradering før betaling.

Behandlingstid

Bestillinger behandles innen 1-3 virkedager etter betalingsbekreftelse. Under helligdager, kampanjer eller perioder med store volum kan behandlingen ta ytterligere 1-2 virkedager.

Du vil motta en e-post med sporingsinformasjon når bestillingen din sendes.

Leveringstider

Bestillinger behandles innen 1-3 virkedager etter betalingsbekreftelse. Leveringsanslag varierer etter destinasjon, transportør, tollbehandling og fraktmetoden som vises i kassen.

  • Standardlevering: gjeldende betalingsanslag vises før betaling.
  • Eekspresslevering: tilgjengelig for noen destinasjoner der vist i kassen.

Dette er estimater. Faktiske leveringstider kan variere på grunn av tollbehandling, transportørforsinkelser, vær, helligdager eller lokale forhold.

Hvordan vår frakt fungerer

  1. Ordre plassert: du mottar en ordrebekreftelse på e-post.
  2. Ordrebehandling: bestillingen din er klargjort etter betalingsbekreftelse.
  3. Sendt: sporingsinformasjon sendes på e-post når tilgjengelig.
  4. I transitt: bruk sporingslenken for operatøroppdateringer.
  5. Leveret: pakken din leveres til adressen oppgitt i kassen.

Ordresporing

Hver bestilling inkluderer et sporingsnummer når transportøren gir et. Sporing kan ta 24-48 timer å oppdatere etter at nummeret er utstedt.

Du kan også sjekke bestillingsstatusen din når som helst ved å besøke siden vår Order Status.

Toll, avgifter og importavgifter

For bestillinger som sendes utenfor USA, kan destinasjonslandet eller transportøren kreve inn importavgifter, skatter, megleravgifter eller tollgebyrer. Disse kostnadene er kundens ansvar med mindre kassen eksplisitt sier at de er inkludert.

Vi kan ikke forutsi disse kostnadene, merke bestillinger som gaver eller senke den deklarerte verdien av en bestilling. Kontakt ditt lokale tollkontor for destinasjonsspesifikk veiledning før du bestiller.

Forsendelsesproblemer

Hvis pakken din er forsinket, mangler eller merket som levert, men ikke mottatt, kontakt oss på info@dresslikemommy.com med bestillingsnummer og sporingsinformasjon. Vi hjelper deg med å gjennomgå operatørinformasjonen og de neste tilgjengelige trinnene.

Kontakt oss

For spørsmål om frakt, send e-post info@dresslikemommy.com.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy

Connect With Us

Der familie-mote møter ekte tilknytning

Dress Like Mommy ble til ut fra en enkel idé: familier som matcher sammen, knytter bånd sammen.

Dress Like Mommy vokste frem fra Franciscos familieidé i Naples, Florida: gleden døtrene hans følte når de hadde matchende antrekk med moren. Den gnisten — latteren, bildene og øyeblikkene med «vi matcher!» — ble kjernen i en virksomhet som bringer familier nærmere hverandre gjennom mote.

Hva vi gjør

Vi setter sammen matchende antrekk for mødre, fedre og barn — fra koselige julepyjamaser til hverdagslige casual sett og antrekk til spesielle anledninger. Hvert plagg er valgt med tanke på komfort, stil og rimelighet, slik at familier overalt kan skape de perfekte øyeblikkene uten å sprenge budsjettet.

Våre kunder

Vi betjener familier i USA, Canada, Storbritannia og Australia. Enten det gjelder matchende pyjamaser på julemorgenen, familiefotografering eller en morsom dag ute i matchende antrekk med barnet ditt, kommer kundene til oss for koordinerte antrekk som gjør det enklere å kle seg sammen.

Kvalitet og omsorg

Hvert produkt i vår kolleksjon går gjennom en nøye utvelgelsesprosess. Vi samarbeider med pålitelige produsenter for å tilby de nyeste familie-matching stilene til rettferdige priser. Hvis noe ikke er som det skal med bestillingen din, er vårt kundeserviceteam her for å rette opp i det.

Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

translations.value:
Retur- og kanselleringsregler

Hos Dress Like Mommy er vi opptatt av at du skal være helt fornøyd med hvert kjøp. Vennligst les gjennom våre retningslinjer for retur og kansellering av bestillinger nedenfor. Hvis du har spørsmål eller trenger hjelp, ta gjerne kontakt med oss på info@dresslikemommy.com.

1. Returer

Berettigelse for retur

  • Tidsramme: Returer godtas innen 30 dager etter kjøpsdato.
  • Tilstand: Varer må returneres i original stand, ubrukt, uvasket og med alle merkelapper festet.
  • Emballasje: Original emballasje må være intakt og alt originalt innhold inkludert.

Ikke-berettigede returer

  • Varer som er skadet, brukt, endret eller mangler deler.
  • Returer uten original bestillingsinformasjon i pakken.

Returfrakt

  • Ansvar: Kjøper er ansvarlig for alle returkostnader.
  • Anbefaling: Bruk en sikker eller sporbar fraktmetode og behold kvittering for sending.

Refusjoner

  • Full refusjon: Utstedes for varer returnert i original stand og emballasje.
  • Delvise refusjoner: Kan trekkes fra hvis varer returneres skadet, brukt eller ufullstendig for å dekke verdifall.
  • Behandlingstid: Refusjoner behandles vanligvis innen 4-6 uker etter mottak av den returnerte pakken. Ofte behandles refusjoner raskere.
  • Verifisering: Refusjoner utbetales ikke før vi mottar de returnerte varene eller gyldig bevis på sending (f.eks. skannet kvittering med dato, tid og sporingsnummer).

2. Kansellering av bestilling

Kanselleringsregler

  • Berettigelse: Bestillinger kan kanselleres innen 12 virketimer etter betaling.
  • Fremgangsmåte: For å kansellere en bestilling, vennligst kontakt oss umiddelbart på info@dresslikemommy.com innen den angitte tidsrammen.
  • Etter sending: Når bestillingen er pakket og sendt, er det ikke lenger mulig å kansellere.

3. Hvordan returnere eller bytte en vare

Returprosess for uegnet eller uønsket vare

  1. Kontakt oss: Send e-post til info@dresslikemommy.com for å starte returen innen 30 dager etter kjøpet.
  2. Forbered pakken: Pakk varen i originalemballasjen, og sørg for at alle etiketter og merkelapper er festet.
  3. Send varen: Send pakken til den oppgitte returadressen med en sikker eller sporbar fraktmetode. Vi anbefaler å bruke det lokale postkontoret for å redusere kostnader. Ta vare på kvitteringen for frakten.
  4. Bekreftelse: Når vi mottar returen din, vil vi behandle refusjonen eller byttet og varsle deg via e-post.

Byttepolicy

  • Gyldige bytter: Kun størrelser og farger av samme vare kan byttes.
  • Ulike modeller: For å bytte til en annen modell, vennligst returner den opprinnelige varen og legg inn en ny bestilling på ønsket produkt.

4. Retur av defekte varer

Hvis du mottar en defekt vare, vennligst følg disse trinnene:

  1. Kontakt kundeservice: Send e-post til info@dresslikemommy.com med følgende informasjon:
    • Ordrenummer
    • Ditt navn og adresse
    • Produktdetaljer (antall, SKU)
    • Beskrivelse av problemet
  2. Legg ved bevis: Inkluder et klart bilde av den defekte varen i e-posten din.
  3. Returinstruksjoner: Vårt kundeserviceteam vil gi deg instruksjoner om hvordan du returnerer den defekte varen for refusjon eller bytte.

5. Tilleggsinformasjon

  • Behandling inkluderer: Refusjonsperioden inkluderer transporttid, returbehandling og refusjonsbehandling.
  • Kontakt oss: For spørsmål eller hjelp med retur og kansellering, vennligst kontakt oss på info@dresslikemommy.com.

6. Varer som ikke kan returneres

  • Personlige eller tilpassede produkter
  • Undertøy
  • Gavekort

7. Kundens rettigheter

Hvis du er bosatt i EU, har du rett til å returnere kjøpet innen 14 dager uten å oppgi noen grunn. For mer informasjon, vennligst kontakt vårt kundeserviceteam.

Takk for at du handlet hos Dress Like Mommy. Vi setter pris på din tillit og jobber for å gi deg den beste handleopplevelsen mulig.

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

translations.value:
Om oss

A. Generelle spørsmål

1. Er dette nettstedet sikkert å bruke?

Ja. Betalingen håndteres sikkert av Shopify, og du kan bruke betalingsmåtene som vises i kassen. Vi lagrer ikke de fullstendige kortopplysningene dine på nettstedet vårt.

 

2. Hvor raskt svarer dere på e-posthenvendelser?

Vi svarer på alle e-poster innen én virkedag.

 

3. Hvor holder dere til?

Dress Like Mommy er en nettbutikk som drives av FKG Trading LLC i Naples, Florida, USA. Vi samarbeider med partnere innen produksjon, ordrebehandling og utsending.

 

4. Hvorfor er dere så billige?

Vi velger ut matchende familieantrekk med tanke på rimelige priser. Priser og eventuelle tilgjengelige rabatter vises på produktsiden og i kassen.

Før du legger inn en bestilling

A. Størrelser

1. Hvor kan jeg finne størrelsestabellen i centimeter?

Bruk størrelsestabellen for det bestemte produktet og den størrelsen du vurderer. Kontroller måleenhetene og om tabellen viser kroppsmål eller plaggets mål. Vår størrelsesguide forklarer hvordan du måler og sammenligner størrelser. Kontakt oss før du bestiller hvis en tabell eller et mål er uklart.

 

2. Vil jeg motta et plagg som er to størrelser større?

Størrelsesbetegnelser og mål varierer med produkt og produsent. Velg hvert plagg ut fra produktets egen størrelsestabell og de tilgjengelige alternativene, i stedet for å anta at din vanlige bokstavstørrelse passer eller bruke en fast størrelsesomregning. Kontakt oss før du bestiller hvis du er usikker.

B. Betalinger

1. Hvilke betalingsmetoder godtar dere?

Vi godtar betalingsmåtene som vises i kassen, inkludert tilgjengelige kortalternativer.

 

2. Jeg vil betale med kredittkort, men blir omdirigert til PayPal-siden?

Velg en tilgjengelig betalingsmåte i kassen. Hvis du velger en tredjeparts betalingsløsning, følger du leverandørens instruksjoner eller velger et annet tilgjengelig alternativ før du betaler.

C. Frakt

1. Hva er fraktprisen?

Standardfrakt er inkludert i produktprisene for land og regioner der en standard fraktmetode er tilgjengelig. Den nøyaktige fraktmetoden, forventet leveringstid og eventuelle oppgraderinger til ekspressfrakt vises i kassen før betaling.

 

2. Leverer dere til mitt land?

Vi sender til landene og områdene som vises i kassen. Hvis landet ditt ikke er oppført i kassen, må du kontakte oss før du legger inn en bestilling.

 

3. Hvor lang tid tar det å få bestillingen min?

Behandlings- og transporttider varierer etter reisemål og transportør. Les fraktvilkårene for oppdaterte leveringsopplysninger før du går til kassen.

 

4. Må jeg betale toll?

Destinasjonslandet kan kreve toll, importavgifter eller lokale gebyrer. Kunden er ansvarlig for disse, med mindre det uttrykkelig står i kassen at de er inkludert. Vi kan ikke merke bestillinger som gaver eller oppgi en lavere verdi på forsendelsene.

Etter at du har lagt inn en bestilling

A. Bestillingsstatus

1. Hva betyr det: bestillingsstatus "Uoppfylt"?

Bestillingen din er ennå ikke merket som ekspedert. Bestillinger behandles vanligvis innen 1-3 virkedager etter at betalingen er bekreftet. Sporingsinformasjon sendes på e-post når den er tilgjengelig etter utsending.

 

2. Hva betyr det: bestillingsstatus "Fulfilled"?

Det betyr at bestillingen din er under sending.

 

3. Det har gått for lang tid, hvor er bestillingen min?

Vennligst sjekk sporingen for mer informasjon. Hvis problemet vedvarer, vennligst send oss en e-post: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Bestillingssporing

1. Hvordan sporer jeg bestillingen min?

Sporingsinformasjon sendes på e-post når den er tilgjengelig etter at bestillingen er sendt. Du kan også se sporingsinformasjonen her: Spor bestillingen din

 

2. Sporingskoden min sier «venter» eller «ingen informasjon tilgjengelig for øyeblikket».

Det kan ta 24-48 timer før sporingen oppdateres etter at sporingsnummeret er utstedt. Hvis informasjonen fortsatt ikke er tilgjengelig eller pakken er forsinket, kan du kontakte oss: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Sporingskoden min sier «utløpt»

Vennligst kontakt oss: info@dresslikemommy.com og vi vil raskt løse dette problemet.

 

4. Hvordan holder jeg meg oppdatert om bestillingssporing?

Bruk sporingslenken for å se de siste oppdateringene fra transportøren. Hvis pakken er forsinket, borte eller merket som levert uten at du har mottatt den, kontakter du oss med bestillingsnummeret og sporingsinformasjonen.

B. Jeg vil endre eller avbestille bestillingen min

1. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil avbestille

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til info@dresslikemommy.com med bestillingsnummeret ditt som emne.

 

2. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil endre farge eller størrelse på varen.

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til info@dresslikemommy.com med ditt nye farge- eller størrelsevalg.

 

3. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil endre leveringsadressen

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til info@dresslikemommy.com med din nye leveringsadresse.

Etter at du mottar en bestilling

A. Jeg vil bytte eller returnere bestillingen min

1. Bestillingen min kom, men varene var to størrelser for store

Størrelsesbetegnelser kan variere. Hvis størrelsen eller målene ikke ser ut til å samsvare med bestillingen din, kontakt info@dresslikemommy.com med ordrenummeret og detaljene. Les våre gjeldende retningslinjer for refusjon før du sender en vare tilbake.

 

2. Bestillingen min kom, men jeg mottok feil varer

Vennligst kontakt oss på info@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Hvis feilen er vår, kan du sende varene tilbake, og vi sender deg riktige varer på vår regning (eller utsteder refusjon).

 

3. Bestillingen min kom, og jeg vil bytte størrelse/farge

Kontakt oss på info@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Godkjente bytter følger de gjeldende refusjonsvilkårene, inkludert krav til varens tilstand og ansvar for returfrakt.

 

4. Bestillingen min kom, men jeg vil returnere den.

Kontakt oss på info@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Les refusjonsvilkårene om hvilke varer som kan returneres, returfrakt og refusjonstid før du sender noe tilbake.

Shipping Information

At Dress Like Mommy, we are an online store that ships matching family outfits to destinations available at checkout through our shipping and fulfillment partners. Here is how to confirm shipping, delivery timing, and tracking before you place an order.

Standard And Express Shipping Options

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Where We Ship

Shipping availability is based on the country/region and address entered at checkout. If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, we can ship there under the displayed method and rate.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown, email us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Processing And Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout. Review the shipping method and estimate shown during checkout before placing your order.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued.

Order Tracking

Once your order ships, check your email for tracking information. You can also visit your account or use the tracking link in the shipping confirmation email when available.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping FAQ

Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
Contact us as soon as possible at info@dresslikemommy.com. If your order has not moved into fulfillment yet, we can review whether an address change is still possible.

Do you ship to P.O. Boxes?
Shipping availability for P.O. Boxes depends on the destination and carrier options shown at checkout.

My package has not arrived yet.
Check your tracking link first. If the tracking has not updated for several business days or the delivery estimate has passed, email us with your order number.

Fraktinformasjon

Dress Like Mommy er en nettbutikk som sender matchende familieantrekk til destinasjoner som er tilgjengelige i kassen, gjennom våre partnere for frakt og ordrebehandling. Her kan du se hvordan du bekrefter frakt, leveringstid og sporing før du bestiller.

Standard- og ekspressfrakt

Standardfrakt er inkludert i produktprisene for land og regioner der en standard fraktmetode er tilgjengelig. I kassen vises den nøyaktige fraktmetoden, forventet leveringstid og eventuell oppgradering til ekspressfrakt før betaling.

Hvor vi sender

Tilgjengelig frakt avhenger av landet/regionen og adressen som oppgis i kassen. Hvis det vises en fraktmetode for adressen din, kan vi sende dit med metoden og prisen som vises.

Hvis destinasjonen din ikke vises i kassen, eller hvis ingen fraktmetode vises, send oss en e-post til info@dresslikemommy.com før du bestiller.

Behandlings- og leveringstider

Bestillinger behandles innen 1-3 virkedager etter betalingsbekreftelse. Under helligdager, kampanjer eller perioder med store volum kan behandlingen ta ytterligere 1-2 virkedager.

Anslått leveringstid varierer med destinasjon, transportør, tollbehandling og fraktmetoden som vises i kassen. Kontroller metoden og leveringsanslaget som vises før du legger inn bestillingen.

Det kan ta 24-48 timer før sporingen oppdateres etter at sporingsnummeret er utstedt.

Ordresporing

Når bestillingen er sendt, sjekk e-posten din for sporingsinformasjon. Du kan også besøke kontoen din eller bruke sporingslenken i e-posten med forsendelsesbekreftelsen når den er tilgjengelig.

Toll, avgifter og importskatter

For bestillinger som sendes utenfor USA, kan destinasjonslandet eller transportøren kreve inn importavgifter, skatter, megleravgifter eller tollgebyrer. Disse kostnadene er kundens ansvar med mindre kassen eksplisitt sier at de er inkludert.

Vi kan ikke forutsi disse kostnadene, merke bestillinger som gaver eller senke den deklarerte verdien av en bestilling. Kontakt ditt lokale tollkontor for destinasjonsspesifikk veiledning før du bestiller.

Vanlige spørsmål om frakt

Kan jeg endre leveringsadressen etter bestilling?
Kontakt oss så snart som mulig på info@dresslikemommy.com. Hvis bestillingen ennå ikke har gått videre til ordreekspedisjon, kan vi undersøke om det fortsatt er mulig å endre adressen.

Sender dere til postbokser?
Om vi kan sende til postbokser, avhenger av destinasjonen og transportøralternativene som vises i kassen.

Pakken min har ikke kommet ennå.
Sjekk sporingslenken først. Hvis sporingen ikke har blitt oppdatert på flere virkedager eller den anslåtte leveringstiden har passert, send oss en e-post med ordrenummeret ditt.

Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Last updated: January 2026

Zwroty & wymiany

Chcemy, aby cała Twoja rodzina pokochała dopasowane do siebie stroje! Jeśli coś jest nie tak, jesteśmy tutaj, aby pomóc.

Termin zwrotu

Masz 30 dni od daty dostawy na zażądanie zwrotu lub wymiany.

Warunki zwrotu

Aby móc dokonać zwrotu, produkty muszą być:

  • Nienoszone, nieprane i w oryginalnym stanie
  • W oryginalnym opakowaniu ze wszystkimi dołączonymi metkami
  • Bez plam, sierści zwierząt, perfum i śladów zużycia

Produkty, których nie można zwrócić

  • Stroje kąpielowe i bielizna (ze względów higienicznych)
  • Elementy oznaczone jako „Final Sale”
  • Karty podarunkowe
  • Przedmioty zwrócone po 30 dniach

Jak rozpocząć zwrot

  1. Wyślij do nas wiadomość e-mail na adres info@dresslikemommy.com, podając numer zamówienia i powód zwrotu
  2. Nasz zespół rozpatrzy Twoją prośbę i odpowie w ciągu 1 dnia roboczego
  3. Dostarczymy instrukcje dotyczące zwrotu i adres wysyłki zwrotnej
  4. Odeślij produkt lub produkty w oryginalnym opakowaniu

Zwroty pieniędzy

Po otrzymaniu i sprawdzeniu Twojego zwrotu:

  • Otrzymasz wiadomość e-mail z potwierdzeniem, że otrzymaliśmy Twój przedmiot
  • Jeśli zostanie zatwierdzony, Twój zwrot środków zostanie przetworzony na pierwotną metodę płatności w ciągu 5–10 dni roboczych
  • W zależności od banku zaksięgowanie kwoty na wyciągu może zająć dodatkowe 2–5 dni roboczych

Wymiana produktów

Chcesz inny rozmiar lub kolor? Wyślij nam e-mail na adres info@dresslikemommy.com, podając numer zamówienia, a pomożemy Ci znaleźć odpowiedni produkt.

Uszkodzone lub wadliwe produkty

Otrzymałeś uszkodzony lub wadliwy przedmiot? Skontaktuj się z nami w ciągu 7 dni od dostawy, przesyłając zdjęcia problemu. Wyślemy zamiennik lub dokonamy pełnego zwrotu pieniędzy — nie ma potrzeby zwracania uszkodzonego produktu.

Opóźnione lub nieotrzymane zwroty pieniędzy

Jeśli nie otrzymałeś zwrotu pieniędzy w ciągu 10 dni roboczych od naszego e-maila z potwierdzeniem:

  1. Sprawdź wyciąg z konta bankowego lub karty kredytowej
  2. Skontaktuj się z wystawcą karty kredytowej — czasy przetwarzania są różne
  3. Skontaktuj się ze swoim bankiem — może wystąpić dodatkowy czas przetwarzania
  4. Napisz do nas na info@dresslikemommy.com, a my zbadamy sprawę

Koszty wysyłki

  • Koszty wysyłki zwrotnej ponosi klient, chyba że przedmiot dotarł uszkodzony lub wadliwy
  • Oryginalne koszty wysyłki nie podlegają zwrotowi

Pytania?

Napisz do nas na info@dresslikemommy.com lub zadzwoń pod numer (786) 309-6006 (pon.–pt., 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Ostatnia aktualizacja: styczeń 2026

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

Dress Like Mommy is operated by FKG Trading LLC, a Florida limited liability company. Your privacy matters to us — this policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

We’ve written this in plain language because we believe you shouldn’t need a law degree to understand how your data is handled.

1. Who We Are

  • Legal Entity: FKG Trading LLC
  • Website: dresslikemommy.com
  • Address: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006

FKG Trading LLC is the data controller for all personal information collected through this website.

2. Information We Collect

Information You Provide Directly

When you shop with us, create an account, or get in touch, you may provide:

  • Contact information — name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping and billing addresses
  • Payment information — credit/debit card details (processed securely by Shopify Payments; we never see or store your full card number)
  • Account credentials — email and password if you create an account
  • Communications — messages you send us via email, contact forms, or social media
  • Order details — products purchased, sizes, quantities

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our site, certain information is collected automatically:

  • Device and browser information — browser type, operating system, screen resolution, device type
  • IP address and approximate location (city/region level)
  • Browsing activity — pages visited, products viewed, time spent on pages, referring website
  • Cookies and similar technologies (see Section 5)

Information from Third Parties

We may receive limited information from:

  • Shopify — our e-commerce platform
  • Payment processors — transaction confirmation and fraud prevention
  • Marketing platforms — if you interact with our ads

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and receipts
  • Respond to your questions and support requests
  • Improve our website, products, and shopping experience
  • Send marketing emails (only with your consent)
  • Detect and prevent fraud
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Personalize your shopping experience

We will never sell your personal information to third parties.

4. Third-Party Services

  • Shopify — powers our online store and processes orders
  • Shopify Payments (Stripe) — PCI-DSS compliant payment processing
  • Email marketing — newsletter delivery; unsubscribe anytime
  • Shipping carriers — deliver your order and provide tracking
  • Google Analytics — aggregated site usage data

We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

5. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to keep your cart active, remember preferences, understand traffic, and support marketing (with consent). Control cookies via your browser settings.

6. Children’s Privacy

Dress Like Mommy sells children’s clothing, but our website is not directed at children. All purchases must be made by an adult (18+). We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16 (or 13 in the US).

7. Data Retention

  • Order records — 7 years for tax/accounting
  • Account info — while active; deleted on request
  • Marketing consent — until you unsubscribe
  • Analytics — anonymized within 26 months
  • Support comms — up to 3 years after resolution

8. Your Rights

All customers can access, correct, unsubscribe from marketing, and request deletion of their data.

GDPR (EEA/UK/Switzerland): Data portability, restrict/object to processing, withdraw consent, lodge complaints.

CCPA (California): Know what we collect, delete data, opt out of sales. We do not sell your data.

Contact: info@dresslikemommy.com. Response within 30 days.

9. Data Security

SSL/TLS encryption, PCI-DSS payment processing, access controls. No method is 100% secure.

10. International Transfers

Shopify servers may be outside your country. EEA/UK/Swiss transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses.

11. Changes

We update the “Last Updated” date for significant changes.

12. Contact Us

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006
  • Mail: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

Privacy Policy by FKG Trading LLC, operator of Dress Like Mommy.

Shipping Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

At Dress Like Mommy, we want your matching outfits to arrive as clearly and reliably as possible. Review the shipping method, rate, and delivery estimate shown at checkout before placing an order.

Where We Ship

Shipping is available to the countries and regions shown at checkout. Availability depends on the destination, product, and shipping methods shown during checkout. Use the country/region selector or the checkout shipping step to confirm whether we can ship to your address before placing an order.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown for your address, contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Shipping Rates

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

You will receive an email with tracking information once your order ships.

Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout.

  • Standard Delivery: the current checkout estimate displays before payment.
  • Express Delivery: available for some destinations where shown at checkout.

These are estimates. Actual delivery times may vary because of customs processing, carrier delays, weather, holidays, or local conditions.

How Our Shipping Works

  1. Order Placed: you receive an order confirmation email.
  2. Order Processing: your order is prepared after payment confirmation.
  3. Shipped: tracking information is emailed when available.
  4. In Transit: use the tracking link for carrier updates.
  5. Delivered: your package is delivered to the address provided at checkout.

Order Tracking

Every order includes a tracking number when the carrier provides one. Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the number is issued.

You can also check your order status anytime by visiting our Order Status page.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders shipped outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These charges are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping Problems

If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and tracking information. We will help review the carrier information and next available steps.

Contact Us

For shipping questions, email info@dresslikemommy.com.

Zasady wysyłki

Ostatnia aktualizacja: styczeń 28, 2026

At Dress Like Mommy chcemy, aby Twoje dopasowane stroje dotarły tak wyraźnie i niezawodnie, jak to możliwe. Przed złożeniem zamówienia sprawdź metodę wysyłki, stawkę i szacunkową dostawę pokazane przy kasie.

Gdzie wysyłamy

Wysyłka jest dostępna do krajów i regionów wskazanych przy kasie. Dostępność zależy od miejsca docelowego, produktu i metod wysyłki pokazanych podczas realizacji transakcji. Skorzystaj z opcji wyboru kraju/regionu lub etapu wysyłki przy kasie, aby przed złożeniem zamówienia potwierdzić, czy możemy wysłać pod Twój adres.

Jeśli miejsce docelowe nie pojawia się przy kasie lub jeśli dla Twojego adresu nie jest wyświetlana żadna metoda wysyłki, przed złożeniem zamówienia skontaktuj się z nami pod adresem info@dresslikemommy.com.

Stawki wysyłki

Standardowa wysyłka jest wliczona w ceny produktów dla krajów i regionów, w których dostępna jest metoda standardowa. Kasa pokazuje dokładną metodę, szacunkową dostawę i wszelkie ekspresowe aktualizacje przed dokonaniem płatności.

Czas przetwarzania

Zamówienia realizowane są w ciągu 1-3 dni roboczych po potwierdzeniu płatności. W święta, promocje lub okresy wzmożonego ruchu przetwarzanie może zająć dodatkowe dni robocze 1-2.

Po wysłaniu zamówienia otrzymasz wiadomość e-mail z informacjami o śledzeniu.

Czasy dostawy

Zamówienia realizowane są w ciągu 1-3 dni roboczych po potwierdzeniu płatności. Szacunkowy czas dostawy różni się w zależności od miejsca docelowego, przewoźnika, procedury celnej i metody wysyłki pokazanej przy kasie.

  • Dostawa standardowa: bieżący szacunkowy koszt realizacji transakcji wyświetla się przed dokonaniem płatności.
  • Dostawa ekspresowa: dostępna dla niektórych miejsc docelowych wskazanych przy kasie.

Są to dane szacunkowe. Rzeczywisty czas dostawy może się różnić ze względu na procedury celne, opóźnienia przewoźnika, pogodę, święta lub warunki lokalne.

Jak działa nasza wysyłka

  1. Złożone zamówienie: otrzymasz e-mail z potwierdzeniem zamówienia.
  2. Przetwarzanie zamówienia: Twoje zamówienie jest przygotowane po potwierdzeniu płatności.
  3. Wysłano: Informacje o śledzeniu są wysyłane e-mailem, jeśli są dostępne.
  4. W transporcie: użyj linku śledzącego, aby uzyskać aktualizacje przewoźnika.
  5. Dostarczono: Twoja paczka zostanie dostarczona pod adres podany przy kasie.

Śledzenie zamówienia

Każde zamówienie zawiera numer śledzenia, jeśli przewoźnik go udostępni. Aktualizacja śledzenia może zająć godziny 24-48 po wydaniu numeru.

Możesz także sprawdzić status swojego zamówienia w dowolnym momencie, odwiedzając naszą stronę Status zamówienia.

Cła, cła i podatki importowe

W przypadku zamówień wysyłanych poza Stany Zjednoczone kraj docelowy lub przewoźnik może pobrać cła importowe, podatki, opłaty maklerskie lub opłaty celne. Za te opłaty odpowiada klient, chyba że w kasie wyraźnie wskazano, że są one uwzględnione.

Nie możemy przewidzieć tych opłat, oznaczyć zamówień jako prezentów ani obniżyć zadeklarowanej wartości zamówienia. Przed złożeniem zamówienia skontaktuj się z lokalnym urzędem celnym, aby uzyskać wskazówki dotyczące konkretnego miejsca docelowego.

Problemy z wysyłką

Jeśli Twoja paczka jest opóźniona, zaginęła lub oznaczona jako dostarczona, ale nie została odebrana, skontaktuj się z nami pod adresem info@dresslikemommy.com, podając numer zamówienia i informacje o śledzeniu. Pomożemy sprawdzić informacje o przewoźniku i kolejne dostępne kroki.

translatableContent.value:
Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it

translations.value:
Nasza historia

Moda rodzinna, która zbliża

Dress Like Mommy powstało z prostej myśli: wspólne stroje pomagają budować rodzinne więzi.

Pomysł na Dress Like Mommy narodził się w rodzinie Francisco w Naples na Florydzie, z radości jego córek, gdy nosiły stroje pasujące do ubrań mamy. Śmiech, zdjęcia i chwile, w których czuły się jak bliźniaczki, stały się sercem firmy, która zbliża rodziny poprzez modę.

Czym się zajmujemy

Wybieramy pasujące stroje dla mam, ojców i dzieci — od przytulnych świątecznych piżam po codzienne komplety i stylizacje na wyjątkowe okazje. Każdy element dobieramy z myślą o wygodzie, stylu i przystępnej cenie, aby rodziny mogły tworzyć piękne wspomnienia bez nadmiernych wydatków.

Nasi klienci

Obsługujemy rodziny w Stanach Zjednoczonych, Kanadzie, Wielkiej Brytanii i Australii. Niezależnie od tego, czy chodzi o pasujące piżamy w świąteczny poranek, rodzinną sesję zdjęciową czy wspólne wyjście w podobnych strojach, nasi klienci szukają u nas zestawów ułatwiających wspólne ubieranie się.

Jakość i troska

Każdy produkt w naszej kolekcji przechodzi staranny proces doboru. Współpracujemy z zaufanymi producentami, aby oferować najnowsze rodzinne stylizacje w uczciwych cenach. Jeśli coś jest nie tak z zamówieniem, nasz zespół obsługi klienta pomoże rozwiązać problem.

Dlaczego warto u nas kupować?

  • Firma rodzinna — Prowadzona przez tatę, który rozumie potrzeby rodzin
  • Standardowa wysyłka w cenie tam, gdzie dostępna jest standardowa metoda wysyłki
  • Rodzinne stylizacje bez trudu — Pasujące stroje na zdjęcia, święta, podróże i codzienne chwile
  • Łatwe zwroty — Jasne zasady zwrotów i wymian w naszej polityce zwrotów
  • Bezpieczne płatności — Twoje dane płatnicze są zawsze chronione

Bądźmy w kontakcie

Uwielbiamy oglądać rodziny w pasujących strojach! Oznacz nas w mediach społecznościowych hasztagiem #DressLikeMommy i podziel się swoimi chwilami.

Masz pytania? Odwiedź stronę Kontakt — zazwyczaj odpowiadamy w ciągu jednego dnia roboczego.

Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Zwroty & wymiany

Chcemy, aby cała Twoja rodzina pokochała dopasowane do siebie stroje! Jeśli coś jest nie tak, jesteśmy tutaj, aby pomóc.

Termin zwrotu

Masz 30 dni od daty dostawy na zażądanie zwrotu lub wymiany.

Warunki zwrotu

Aby móc dokonać zwrotu, produkty muszą być:

  • Nienoszone, nieprane i w oryginalnym stanie
  • W oryginalnym opakowaniu ze wszystkimi dołączonymi metkami
  • Bez plam, sierści zwierząt, perfum i śladów zużycia

Produkty, których nie można zwrócić

  • Stroje kąpielowe i bielizna (ze względów higienicznych)
  • Elementy oznaczone jako „Final Sale”
  • Karty podarunkowe
  • Przedmioty zwrócone po 30 dniach

Jak rozpocząć zwrot

  1. Wyślij do nas wiadomość e-mail na adres info@dresslikemommy.com, podając numer zamówienia i powód zwrotu
  2. Nasz zespół rozpatrzy Twoją prośbę i odpowie w ciągu 1 dnia roboczego
  3. Dostarczymy instrukcje dotyczące zwrotu i adres wysyłki zwrotnej
  4. Odeślij produkt lub produkty w oryginalnym opakowaniu

Zwroty pieniędzy

Po otrzymaniu i sprawdzeniu Twojego zwrotu:

  • Otrzymasz wiadomość e-mail z potwierdzeniem, że otrzymaliśmy Twój przedmiot
  • Jeśli zostanie zatwierdzony, Twój zwrot środków zostanie przetworzony na pierwotną metodę płatności w ciągu 5–10 dni roboczych
  • W zależności od banku zaksięgowanie kwoty na wyciągu może zająć dodatkowe 2–5 dni roboczych

Wymiana produktów

Chcesz inny rozmiar lub kolor? Wyślij nam e-mail na adres info@dresslikemommy.com, podając numer zamówienia, a pomożemy Ci znaleźć odpowiedni produkt.

Uszkodzone lub wadliwe produkty

Otrzymałeś uszkodzony lub wadliwy przedmiot? Skontaktuj się z nami w ciągu 7 dni od dostawy, przesyłając zdjęcia problemu. Wyślemy zamiennik lub dokonamy pełnego zwrotu pieniędzy — nie ma potrzeby zwracania uszkodzonego produktu.

Opóźnione lub nieotrzymane zwroty pieniędzy

Jeśli nie otrzymałeś zwrotu pieniędzy w ciągu 10 dni roboczych od naszego e-maila z potwierdzeniem:

  1. Sprawdź wyciąg z konta bankowego lub karty kredytowej
  2. Skontaktuj się z wystawcą karty kredytowej — czasy przetwarzania są różne
  3. Skontaktuj się ze swoim bankiem — może wystąpić dodatkowy czas przetwarzania
  4. Napisz do nas na info@dresslikemommy.com, a my zbadamy sprawę

Koszty wysyłki

  • Koszty wysyłki zwrotnej ponosi klient, chyba że przedmiot dotarł uszkodzony lub wadliwy
  • Oryginalne koszty wysyłki nie podlegają zwrotowi

Pytania?
